name: Poison
description: All attacks against this figure gain +1 Attack. A heal removes poison but does not restore HP.

name: Wound
description: This figure suffers 1 damage at the start of each turn. A heal removes wound but does not restore HP.

name: Stun
description: Cannot perform any abilities. Removed at end of next turn.

name: Disarm
description: Cannot perform Attack abilities. Removed at end of next turn.

name: Immobilize
description: Cannot perform Move abilities. Removed at end of next turn.

name: Muddle
description: Disadvantage on all attacks. Removed at end of next turn.

name: Curse
description: A Curse card (null) is shuffled into the attack modifier deck. Removed when revealed, or at end of scenario.

name: Strengthen
description: Advantage on all attacks. Removed at end of next turn.

name: Bless
description: A Bless card (2x) is shuffled into the attack modifier deck. Removed when revealed, or at end of scenario.
